mo_ta_cong_viec:
Mid_Senior Fullstack:
Development
Design, develop, and maintain high-quality web applications using JS/TS and Cloud services.
Analyze client requirements and translate them into efficient, scalable, and maintainable code.
Work in an Agile development team, collaborating closely with developers, product managers, and stakeholders.
Participate in sprint planning, daily stand-ups, and retrospectives to ensure continuous improvement.
Optimize applications for performance, reliability, and scalability.
Testing, Debugging, and Troubleshooting
Conduct thorough testing of web applications to ensure functionality, security, and performance.
Work closely with the QC team to identify and resolve bugs or issues promptly.
Debug and troubleshoot production issues to maintain application stability.
Security and Compliance
Implement security best practices to protect applications from vulnerabilities and cyber threats.
Ensure compliance with data protection and privacy regulations.
Monitor and enhance application security using Cloud security tools.
Documentation
Create and maintain technical documentation, including API specifications, system architecture, and user guides.
Maintain up-to-date documentation for knowledge sharing and future reference.
Collaboration and Communication
Work closely with product managers, designers, and other engineers in an Agile environment to understand project requirements and deliver solutions.
Actively participate in team discussions, code reviews, and collaborative decision-making.
Effectively communicate technical concepts to non-technical stakeholders.
Continuous Learning
Stay updated with the latest trends and technologies in Next.js, Azure, and software development.
Continuously improve coding skills and adopt best practices for efficient development.
Engage in Agile best practices, including continuous integration and deployment.
 
===
Technical leader:
Ensure project quality and delivery timelines through code reviews, technical design decisions, and early identification of technical risks
Define and maintain development standards, code review processes, and quality guidelines aligned with Japanese software development practices
Drive AI tool adoption (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) across the team to improve development productivity
Provide technical guidance and training to team members to achieve high performance
Provide technical leadership on basic and detailed design, including generative AI projects
Understand business goals and provide technical solutions to contribute to business success
Collaborate with other departments to ensure alignment between project goals and technical solutions
yeu_cau:
Requirements for Middle_Senior Fullstack:
Required:
Solid experience building both the frontend and backend of web apps, strong JS/TypeScript, and comfortable working with modern frontend and backend frameworks in general.
Understanding Infrastructure as Code and CI/CD in practice (e.g. has worked with Terraform, GitHub Actions or similar) 
Cloud (AWS/GCP/Azure)
Nice to have: 
Hands-on experience with our current project stacks specifically (Next.js, Remix, NestJS, HonoJS), plus anything around AI — we're especially interested in candidates who've built AI agents or worked with RAG/LLM integration, given where we're heading as a company.
Requirements for Technical leader Fullstack:
Required:
Proven experience leading a development team through technical leadership
Experience working on projects with Japanese clients
5+ years of engineering experience with strong programming skills (TypeScript, JavaScript, Python, Java, Go, or equivalent)
Hands-on experience with AWS for server-side design and development
High proficiency in English (reading, writing, and speaking) for international project communication
Business acumen to understand business goals and contribute from a technical perspective
Experience integrating AI tools (e.g., Cursor, Claude Code) into development workflows and driving team adoption
Hands-on experience with modern web frameworks (React, Vue.js, Next.js, FastAPI, etc.)
Hands-on experience with IaC and CI/CD pipelines (Terraform, AWS CDK, etc.)
Preferred:
Experience with agile development methodologies, pair programming, or mob programming
Proven experience in AI development projects (e.g., Azure OpenAI, AWS Bedrock, GCP Vertex AI)
Experience supporting team members' AI utilization and technical growth
Experience with Azure or Google Cloud in addition to AWS
